Multiple rows of the same Type ("Analysed"), stacked directly together as real usage would repeat them -- demonstrates that table-cell's bounded column widths and table-row's align-items:stretch (equal row height from the tallest cell) actually line up column-for-column and row-for-row once rows share an identical cell composition, deliberately mixing a short 1-line description with a long 2-line one so the height-from-tallest-cell behavior is visible.
